mission.title: Reconnaissance
mission.description: Gather data on the insecticide and the Merovingian's Operation Omega.

phase.briefing:
We find ourselves in need of data, {player}. We have identified two locations of interest. The first contains data pertaining to the creation of insecticide; the second holds information regarding the Merovingian's "Operation Omega."
I am updating your display with the coordinates of the first location.

enter.say:
Okay... according to the Machine research so far, it takes three components to create the insecticide. This building is where the Zion operatives got some of their supplies.
You don't need to get any actual ingredients. Just look around for shipping receipts and find out what supplies have been through this building.
And try to keep a low profile, 'kay?

done.say: Hmm... that doesn't seem to be the right file. Keep looking around...
That's it! Get that file to a hardline.

objective.text: Upload the file at a hardline

phase.briefing:
Very interesting. Along with our samples obtained from the Zion operatives, these will allow us to begin production of the insecticide shortly.
Now we require that you investigate a Merovingian location. We have confirmed the existence of data regarding Operation Omega.

enter.say:
This is the spot. Expect some resistance in here.
I almost don't want to know what this operation is. I mean, your name on a list along with Morpheus... and we both know what happened to him.

objective.text: Search the first computer for Operation Omega data

done.say: I don't like the sound of that. Looking for other subjects?

objective.text: Search the second computer for Operation Omega data
Search the third computer for Operation Omega data

done.say:
So that's how they killed Morpheus. And you're on the same list... you haven't noticed any Merovingian operatives hanging around lately, have you? Oh, damn...
This is not good, {player}.

mission.finish:
This truly is disturbing news, {player}. You are a highly valued asset.
Production of the insecticide has begun. Remain vigilant. We do not know what level of danger you are in.
